section.title: Daily report
section.p: The daily report covers the previous calendar day.
Figures in this report are provisional. Confirm them against the audited ledger before publication.

section.title: Weekly report
section.p: The weekly report covers the seven days ending on Sunday.
Figures in this report are provisional. Confirm them against the audited ledger before publication.

section.title: Monthly report
section.p: The monthly report covers a full calendar month.
Figures in this report are provisional. Confirm them against the audited ledger within five working days.
